HEADLINE: bar_contact 12.7% -> 9.0% absolute (-29%), the FIRST intervention in the campaign to
move it (altitude PI, tilt comp and 12 m look-ahead all left it at ~13%). capture +1.0pp.
BUT the probe refutes both mechanisms we predicted:
hit_in_tokens 0.647 -> 0.40-0.53 (WORSE despite capacity 5->8, and token_rank ~2.9 shows the
extra slots ARE used) => capacity was not the binding constraint; 8 tokens still cannot cover
the ~16 bars in range, and "nearest N" is the wrong selection rule in a dense field.
token_err 0.57 m -> 0.72-1.13 m (WORSE despite halving the angular bin) => H2 was wrong, the
token position error is not dominated by angular quantization.
The gain therefore came from somewhere else (most likely the denser static scan itself), not
from the token mechanism we were aiming at.
